card.name: Mired in Doubt
card.text: Sneak {W} (You may cast this spell for {W} if you also return an unblocked attacker you control to hand during the declare blockers step.) When Mired in Doubt enters the battlefield, exile target nonland permanent an opponent controls until Mired in Doubt leaves the battlefield.

card.name: Stern Excision
card.text: Exile target nonland permanent. Its controller may a return a card from their graveyard to their hand.

card.name: Prohibit
card.text: Kicker {2} (You may pay an additional {2} as you cast this spell.) Counter target spell if its mana value is 2 or less. If Prohibit was kicked, counter that spell if its mana value is 4 or less instead.

card.name: Cryptic Philosopher
card.text: Flying Whenever Cryptic Philosopher attacks, look the top two cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and exile the other with a riddle counter on it. {1}{U}: Put target card in exile with a riddle counter on it into its owner's hand.

card.name: Shadow of Lursk
card.text: Whenever you dream, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life. (Putting a card into your hand from anywhere other than your library is dreaming.)

card.name: In the Thrall of Self-Reflection
card.text: Whenever you dream, you draw a card and you lose 1 life. (Putting a card into your hand from anywhere other than your library is dreaming.)

card.name: Avaricious Knightmare
card.text: Kicker {2} (You may pay an additional {2} as you cast this spell.) When Avaricious Knightmare enters the battlefield, create a Treasure token. If Avaricious Knightmare was kicked, create two of those tokens instead. (It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Add one mana of any color.")

card.name: Furnace Dreamkite
card.text: Flying Whenever you dream, Furnace Dreamkite deals 2 damage to any target. (Putting a card into your hand from anywhere other than your library is dreaming.) Whenever Furnace Dreamkite attacks, return target card from your graveyard to your hand unless any player has Furnace Dreamkite deal 2 damage to them.

card.name: Latent Courage
card.text: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you've dreamed this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on Latent Courage. (Putting a card into your hand from anywhere other than your library is dreaming.)

card.name: Basal Predator
card.text: Kicker {2}{G} (You may pay an additional {2}{G} as you cast this spell.) Reach, vigilance, trample Basal Predator enters the battlefield with X +1/+1 counters on it. If it was kicked, it enters the battlefield with twice that many counters on it instead.

card.name: Before You Wake
card.text: Sneak {4} (You may cast this spell for {4} if you also return an unblocked attacker you control to hand during the declare blockers step.) Destroy target nonland permanent.

card.name: Horn and Ivory
card.text: You may pay {1} and return a land you control to its owner's hand rather than pay Horn and Ivory's mana cost. Horn and Ivory enters the battlefield tapped. {T}: Add one mana of any color.

card.name: Pleasure Principle
card.text: Mill three cards, then you may return a land card from your graveyard to your hand. If you don't put a card into your hand this way, create a tapped Treasure token. (It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Add one mana of any color.")

card.name: Gilded Preconscious
card.text: Gilded Preconscious enters the battlefield tapped. When it enters the battlefield, if you played it, you may return target creature you control to its owner's hand. {T}: Add {G} or {W}.

card.name: Hallowed Spur
card.text: Hallowed Spur enters the battlefield tapped. When it enters the battlefield, if you played it, you may return target creature you control to its owner's hand. {T}: Add {W} or {U}.

card.name: Liminal Growth
card.text: Liminal Growth enters the battlefield tapped. When it enters the battlefield, if you played it, you may return target creature you control to its owner's hand. {T}: Add {R} or {G}.

card.name: Shimmering Cathexis
card.text: Shimmering Cathexis enters the battlefield tapped. When it enters the battlefield, if you played it, you may return target creature you control to its owner's hand. {T}: Add {U} or {B}.

card.name: Latent Strife
